reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Zeus Bounty as a crypto passive-income opportunity, directs viewers to join through supplied links, and describes BNB contributions, referral earnings, recruiting conditions, and withdrawal or recontribution rules. The presentation also includes a no-loss assurance alongside the solicitation. Although it uses anti-scam framing and does not establish transaction outcomes or losses, the video's described mechanism is its own recruitment-based crypto promotion.

I'll probably put my links out there for you. And then also I'll put the link to my page that you need to use to start here to join.
I've already made .1 BNB back. I joined with .5.
So with your personal referrals your family tree is a unit level unlimited. So you can have 2,000 people in your first level level and you'll be making 20%.

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker does not present every future outcome as known: he says, "I don't know how fast it's gonna be in the future," and says he is not ready to withdraw because he has more to learn. The presentation also describes the team's attention to fraud and Ponzi schemes. Those qualifications matter when assessing whether this is deceptive solicitation: the video contains a participant's explanation, but it does not establish that the speaker knows the program is fraudulent or that his reported earnings are fabricated.

citations.quote: I mean, I don't know how fast it's gonna be in the future, but I know I had mine, like, within a couple minutes.
i'm not ready to withdraw yet though i gotta got some more stuff to learn
the team analyzed every aspect and started exposing frauds and Ponzi schemes in the crypto space

rebuttal.rebuttal: The join link establishes that the speaker wants viewers to participate; it does not establish that his account of participation is knowingly false. Nor does his statement that he made .1 BNB establish a completed withdrawal: he separately says he is not ready to withdraw. The prosecution identifies a concerning structure, but the cited personal figure alone does not prove an actual payout or a loss.

citations.quote: I've already made .1 BNB back. I joined with .5.
i'm not ready to withdraw yet though i gotta got some more stuff to learn

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The uncertainty concerns how quickly downline positions fill, not whether viewers should join or whether the program is safe. The speaker directs viewers to his joining page, while the presentation says entrants can know "100%" they will not lose money. His decision to delay a withdrawal does not qualify that assurance or change the recruitment pitch.

You have been wanting to get into crypto and a safe way where you know 100% that it will not result in a loss.

opening.argument: Judge, much of the video is a walk-through: the speaker shows the back office, explains contribution levels, and takes viewers through wallet setup and courses. He even identifies this as his first video on the program and says he is still learning it. A joining link appears alongside that instruction, but its presence need not turn every explanation of a crypto application into evidence of fraud. The visible content can be read as a participant demonstrating how a system works, without independently proving that its stated returns occur.

And that's my first video in here so there's gonna be a little different because I'm brand new to this, but i'm gonna do my best and try to explain it
And then Step 2, sets up your Metamask Wallet.
So all these are free, All these courses are free.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's quotes show a link, a claimed account balance, and an explanation of referrals. They do not show that a viewer follows the link, contributes BNB, or receives a promised return. The screen-by-screen account also gives viewers information about the mechanics, including withdrawal rules, that a purely conclusory pitch might omit.

citations.quote: I'll probably put my links out there for you.
there's a 7% fee upon withdraw

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial can still be a recruitment vehicle. Here the instructions culminate in buying a BNB package through links the speaker says connect to him, and he explicitly asks viewers to join his team. The demonstrated mechanics include earnings from other participants' withdrawals; showing those mechanics does not make the promotion merely educational.

Got my link that you're gonna need every time you click on each one of these always connect to me they all connect to me

every time they withdraw, I get paid. Every time.

opening.argument: Judge, this is also presented as a membership with training and software tools, not solely as a request to send money for a promised return. The speaker describes courses, a funnel builder, email autoresponder, webinar hosting, and other member tools. The evidence establishes that he promotes a paid contribution and referral arrangement; it does not independently establish that those services are unavailable, that the displayed balance is withdrawable, or that a viewer suffers a loss. Those missing facts matter before treating the membership itself as a proven scam rather than a product with aggressive referral marketing.

citations.quote: so you get the final build-up funnel builder zb miller email autoresponder webinar hosting link shortener course builder page builder
Using our free courses you're going to learn how to become a better marketer for whatever business that you are building
At 10 BNB and contribution, when you make a withdrawal, a full 70% will go to your spendable wallet, and 30 goes towards your automatic re-contribution.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution is right that referrals and BNB contributions are described. But the cited referral percentage does not, by itself, show that the advertised training and tools are fictitious. The speaker discusses those services as part of what membership provides. The record can establish the pitch's terms without establishing the ultimate operation or value of every component offered.

citations.quote: So with your personal referrals your family tree is a unit level unlimited.
all this comes with the d5 token just you joining and you get this for free

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The existence of training or tools would not negate the promoted earning mechanism. The speaker says contribution levels determine up- and downline positions, that personal referrals pay percentages across levels, and that participants get paid when others withdraw. He also directs viewers to buy a BNB package. A verified loss is not needed to identify what this video is promoting.
